action_items.item_text: Appellant seeks leave to place Annexure A-1 to A-5 on record
action_items.evidence_quote: the appellant may kindly be permitted to place on record Annexure A-1 to A-5 in the interest of justice

action_items.item_text: Appellant applies to stay operation of the arbitral award and additional award
action_items.evidence_quote: the operation of award dated 19.02.2017 and additional award dated 11.04.2017 passed by learned Arbitral Tribunal may kindly be stayed, in the interest of justice

action_items.item_text: Pleaded consequence if stay is not granted
action_items.evidence_quote: if the operation of award dated 19.02.2017 and additional award dated 11.04.2017 passed by learned Arbitral Tribunal is not stayed the appellant would suffer an irreparable loss

action_items.item_text: Prayer to set aside trial court judgment and arbitral awards

action_items.item_text: Prayer for exemption from filing certified/typed copies of Annexure A-1 to A-5
action_items.evidence_quote: the appellant may kindly be exempted from filing certified/ typed copies of Annexure A-1 to A-5 in the interest of justice

action_items.item_text: Court dismisses the objection petition with costs (disposition event)
action_items.evidence_quote: the objection petition is hereby dismissed with costs

action_items.item_text: Registry directed to retain arbitration record until limitation period for appeal/revision expires
action_items.evidence_quote: the arbitration record be kept till the expiry of limitation period of appeal/revision and thereafter, be sent back to the concerned arbitrator

action_items.item_text: Testing & commissioning of sub-stations due within 18 months of contract signing
action_items.date_text: within 18 months from date of signing of contract
action_items.evidence_quote: the testing and commissioning of all the sub-stations is completed within 18 months from the date of signing of contract as per clause 11 SCC

action_items.item_text: Contract agreement to be signed within 30 days of notification of award/LOA
action_items.date_text: within 30 days of notification of award / issue of letter of acceptance
action_items.anchor_event: notification of award / issue of letter of acceptance
action_items.evidence_quote: The contract agreement will be signed within 30 days of notification of award / issue of letter of acceptance

action_items.item_text: Bank guarantee claim must be lodged with bank on/before fixed date
action_items.evidence_quote: The Guarantee is conditional on a claim being lodged with us at our counters on or before 20.02.2011

action_items.item_text: Stage penalty of 1%/week levied for shortfall against staged financial-achievement targets
action_items.evidence_quote: failing which the stage penalty @1% per week or part thereof for the amount equal to short fall in progress achieved will be levied

action_items.item_text: Liquidated damages of 0.5% of contract price per delayed portion, capped at 10%
action_items.evidence_quote: Half percent (0.5 %) of the contract price for the delayed portion of the work delivery part there of subject to a maximum of 10% of the contract value
